## Observation

AGENTS.md says `make test` "selects exactly what CI's gating `ubuntu-latest, py3.13` cell selects". The selection markers match, but the installed packages do not:
- CI's gating pytest job installs `uv sync --locked --extra dev --extra reviewbot --extra ui --extra grounding-terraform` (.github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml, line 495).
- `make install` runs `uv sync --locked --extra dev --extra metrics` (Makefile, line 101).

Tests guarded by `pytest.importorskip("fastapi")` and similar are therefore skipped locally and only run in CI. On 2026-10-29, `make verify` passed on Gerrit 3141 (19,819 passed, 88 skipped) while CI failed `tests/unit/test_review_bot.py::test_lifespan_drains_queued_events_on_shutdown`, which `make verify` had skipped because the worktree venv had no fastapi.

vampiric-dollfaced-aurochs fixed the CI side of this (no lane installed the reviewbot extra); the local install was not aligned.

## Plan
1. In the Makefile, name the extras once (a `TEST_EXTRAS` variable holding `reviewbot ui grounding-terraform`) and have `install` sync `dev metrics` plus those, and `install-unlocked` install the same set. `make worktree` provisions through `make install`, so it follows.
2. Add `tests/unit/test_install_extras_parity.py`. It reads the extras named by `--extra` on the gating pytest job's `uv sync` line in `.github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml`, removes `dev` (which `install` names separately), and asserts the result equals the Makefile's `TEST_EXTRAS` as a set. A second assertion checks that the `install` recipe's `uv sync` line and `install-unlocked`'s pip line both expand `TEST_EXTRAS`. `metrics` stays an install-only extra and is not part of the comparison.
3. Rewrite the `docs/local-dev-env.md` section "Running the tests CI runs": it currently says `make install` deliberately stays lean and skips ~38 tests, which contradicts AGENTS.md's statement that `make verify` is the locally checkable half of Verified.

## Acceptance criteria
- [x] `tests/unit/test_install_extras_parity.py` passes, and fails when an extra is added to or removed from either the gating cell's `uv sync` line (excluding `dev`) or `TEST_EXTRAS`.
- [x] The parity test fails when `install` stops expanding `TEST_EXTRAS`.
- [x] After `make install`, `python -c "import fastapi"` succeeds in the venv.
- [x] `make verify` in a freshly provisioned worktree reports fewer skips than 88, and none from a missing reviewbot, ui or grounding-terraform package.

## File impact (expected)
- Makefile
- tests/unit/ (new parity test)
- docs/local-dev-env.md
